description: On-screen information display during gameplay. HUD area must be left clear in generated backgrounds.
prompt_template:
Given this gameplay pick:
{prior_picks.gameplay_style}

Generate {count} HUD options covering:
- Presence: always_on | contextual | minimal | none
- Position: top_strip | bottom_strip | corners | floating | edge_indicators
- Info density: minimal (just one number) | moderate | dense
- Visual treatment: text_only | icons_plus_text | sprites_only | dithered_panels
- shows: array of strings naming what's displayed ('score', 'time', 'health', 'inventory_count', etc)

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the HUD option below per the user feedback. Ensure the picked position doesn't conflict with the dialog_style portrait position.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.position: enum: top_strip | bottom_strip | corners | floating | edge_indicators
